type Shape={kind:"s";value?:string}|{kind:"n";value:number|undefined};
const c:Required<Shape>={kind:"s",value:undefined};

type Indexed<T extends {value:object}> = {[K in keyof T["value"]]-?:T["value"][K]};
const indexed:Indexed<{value:{x:string|undefined}|{x?:number}}>={x:undefined};
type Direct = {[K in keyof ({x:string|undefined}|{x?:number})]-?:({x:string|undefined}|{x?:number})[K]};
const direct:Direct={x:undefined};
